sentenceSets.sentence: The inscription appeared to antedate the building by several centuries, suggesting the stone was reused.

answerChoices.reasoning: Predate means to exist before in time, nearly identical to antedate, but is more general and doesn't specifically imply chronological assignment.
Precede means to come before in time or order, close to antedate but doesn't specifically convey the act of assigning an earlier date.
Originate means to come into being, which the inscription did, but doesn't convey the sense of being older than something else.
Postdate means to assign a date later than the actual date, directly opposite in meaning but uses the same date-assigning framework.
Precondition means to prepare in advance, but doesn't relate to chronological dating or assignment of dates.
Anticipate means to foresee or expect beforehand, but doesn't convey the specific act of assigning an earlier date.
Foreshadow means to indicate or warn of beforehand, but doesn't relate to chronological dating.
Establish means to set up or create, but doesn't specifically convey chronological dating or temporal relationships.
Occur means to take place or happen, but doesn't convey the act of assigning a date or temporal relationship.
Modernize means to make modern or update, opposite to the sense of being ancient that antedate implies.
Contemporize means to make of the same time period, opposite to assigning an inscription to an earlier era.

sentenceSets.sentence: The archaeologist's discovery proved that human settlement in the region antedated the accepted historical record by at least five thousand years.

answerChoices.reasoning: Preceded means came before in time, which the settlement did, but doesn't convey the act of revising or reassigning chronological understanding.
Predated means existed before in time, nearly synonymous with antedate, but doesn't specifically emphasize the evidence-based chronological revision.
Superseded means replaced or took the place of, which the discovery does to historical understanding, but doesn't specifically mean older in date.
Invalidated means made invalid or nullified, which the discovery does to the accepted record, but doesn't specifically mean older.
Contradicted means opposed or conflicted with, which the discovery does to accepted history, but doesn't emphasize temporal precedence.
Challenged means questioned or disputed, which the evidence does to the historical record, but doesn't specifically convey older dating.
Undermined means weakened or damaged, which the discovery does to accepted history, but doesn't specifically mean temporally prior.
Revised means changed or corrected, which the discovery causes to historical understanding, but doesn't specifically mean older.
Confirmed means verified or validated, opposite to the discovery revising and pushing back the dates of human settlement.
Supported means provided evidence for, which the discovery does, but opposite to antedating, which suggests contrary to previous acceptance.
Modernized means made more recent or contemporary, opposite to settlement that antedates or goes back further in time.

sentenceSets.sentence: The forger attempted to antedate the document to make it appear as though the contract had been signed years before the dispute actually began.

answerChoices.reasoning: Backdate means to assign a date earlier than the true date, nearly identical to antedate, but may suggest more casual adjustment.
Predate means to exist before in time, which the forged document attempts to do, but doesn't convey the deliberate act of falsifying dates.
Falsify means to make false or alter, which the forger does, but doesn't specifically refer to date manipulation.
Fraudulently alter means to change dishonestly, which the forgery involves, but is too broad and doesn't specify date manipulation.
Forge means to create a false version, which the criminal does, but doesn't specifically address the dating of the document.
Tamper means to interfere or make unauthorized changes, which the forger does, but doesn't specifically mean changing dates.
Counterfeit means to make an illegal copy, which the forger does, but doesn't specifically address date manipulation.
Misrepresent means to give a false or misleading impression, which the forgery does, but doesn't specifically mean dating.
Validate means to confirm or support, opposite to the fraudulent dating intended by the forger.
Authenticate means to prove genuine or true, opposite to the false dating the forger attempts.
Certify means to confirm officially, opposite to the fraudulent alteration the forger commits.
